invariants.rationale: The method assigns the parameter 'name' to the field 'this.name', so at exit they should be equal.
If 'name' is null, 'this.name' may be null as assigned; otherwise, 'this.name' has at least the value of 'name'.
If 'this.name' is not null, it will be equal to 'name' since it was just assigned to it.
